name: brain-token
description: Registers your BrainMCP server using a static bearer token instead of the browser OAuth login

url.title: BrainMCP server URL
url.description: The server's MCP endpoint, ending in /mcp (for example https://brain.example.com/mcp). Give the endpoint, not the site root.

token.title: Bearer token
token.description: A token from the server's MCP_STATIC_BEARER_TOKENS_RO (read-only) or MCP_STATIC_BEARER_TOKENS (read-write) list.
